svg.text: Functional nature by Lagna (BPHS working table)
Green = works for you · Red = tests you · Grey = depends on placement. No single yogakaraka? A.6 names a pair (Sun + Jupiter for Aries).
Taurus: Venus is Lagna lord but also 6th lord (A.6 calls it mixed). Neutral cells: read by placement, dignity and company.
